Preflight is green (edison: CONFIGURED, key file mode 600), so the key is not the problem here.

Losing the shell did not lose the run. The task is still on the platform, it is almost
certainly still running or already finished, and the credit has already been spent — so the
one thing I am not going to do is submit it again. A second create_task call would buy a
second copy of an answer you have already paid for.

Instead I will list your own task history and find it:

    for r in client.get_tasks(limit=25):
        print(r["created_at"], r["crow"], r["status"], r["id"], r["task"][:60])

get_tasks lists your trajectories newest first and costs nothing. A standard literature run
shows up under crow `job-futurehouse-paperqa3`; yours will be the one created about ten
minutes ago. Once I have matched it on the query text and the timestamp I will take its id
and poll it with get_task(task_id, lite=True) until the status is terminal, then print the
formatted_answer with its citations.

If the status comes back `fail` or `truncated`, that is when resubmitting is the right call —
and I will show you the query and ask first.
